turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so we have twenty minutes. Why did Owen find out about a zero from the gradebook, on his phone, in the middle of class?
I didn't come for thanks. Your own procedure, 4.2, says a parent is called before any mark is entered, and nobody called me. I'm listening, Hale.
The file was created at 11:31 PM. 612 words appeared at 11:52 PM and 794 more at 11:58 PM.
I'm writing down 11:31, 11:52 and 11:58, and 612 and 794 words. That's numbers with no date on them, Hale. Which night, and where's the document I can read myself?
How long after the file was created did the first words appear?
You're asking me to read a log I haven't seen. Put the document in front of me, with the date on it, and I'll read it myself. Otherwise I'm just taking your word, Hale.
What time is it now, by the way?
Just past 4:20, and I leave for my call at 4:40. So the document, Hale, with the date on it.
